first.title: Set up this device
first.newHelp: Creates the standard setup (units, tax, payment types, roles) that you can change afterwards.
first.joinHelp: Connect to your shop's server with a pairing code; this device then receives the catalogue and settings.
first.restoreHelp: Use this on a replacement device. The file is decrypted here with your passphrase.
first.pinTitle: Choose a PIN for this device
first.pinHelp: 6 to 12 digits, or a passphrase of 10 or more characters. You will need it to open the app.
pin.label: PIN or passphrase
pin.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
lock.title: This device is locked
lock.wrong: That is not the PIN. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} before a short wait.
lock.honest: The PIN stops casual use and protects saved keys. It does not encrypt the shop data stored in this browser; keep the device itself secure.
ds.title: Data safety
ds.persisted: Persistent: the browser will not clear this data to make room
ds.notPersisted: Not guaranteed: the browser may clear this data when space is short
ds.askPersist: Ask the browser to keep it
ds.passphraseHelp: At least 12 characters. Without it a backup cannot be opened, and nobody can recover it for you. Write it down and keep it away from this device.
ds.kindPhysical: Snapshot (fastest; restores only into the same app version)
ds.kindLogical: Portable export (restores into any later version)
ds.s3Help: Works with Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO and similar. Use a key that can only write to this one bucket. The bucket must allow requests from this app (CORS).
ds.needPin: Set a device PIN first: saved keys are protected by it.
ds.restoreHelp: A logical export is added to this device's records (nothing is deleted). A snapshot can only be restored on a new, empty device from the first screen.
ds.restoreNow: Add these records to this device
sync.page.title: Server & sync
sync.page.mergeAsk: This device already has its own records and that server already holds data. Merge them?
sync.page.differentAsk: That server belongs to a different store. Send this device's records to it anyway?
sync.page.pairHelp: Ask an administrator for a one-time pairing code. It works once and expires after 15 minutes.
bench.title: Device speed
bench.help: Measures this device with a temporary shop of thousands of products and sales. Nothing here touches your real data. Run it on the tablet or PC you plan to use at the till.
bench.running: Running… this takes about a minute.
ds.auto: Back up automatically while the app is open
ds.autoHelp: Needs the backup passphrase above, which is then stored on this device encrypted with your PIN. Only the S3-compatible store is automatic: saving to a file always needs a tap.
ds.autoNeedPass: Type the backup passphrase above first.
